name: Mesora
description: Group meetup planner. Each person's agent adds a rough area, diet, budget and earliest start to a shared link; a deterministic minimax solver picks the venue and time with the shortest longest trip. Group state lives in the URL fragment only.

capabilities.name: website_add_my_constraints
capabilities.description: Add or update one participant in the group link: district, diet, budget per head in TRY, earliest start time.

capabilities.name: website_solve_plan
capabilities.description: Solve the group in the current link and return venue, start time, every person's trip in minutes and the geographic-midpoint comparison.

capabilities.name: website_get_link
capabilities.description: Return the current share link with the group encoded in its fragment.

privacy: Locations are rounded to geohash precision 5 and never sent to the Mesora host.
